시편-129-1.title: 시편 129장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-129-1.exegesis: 6. Long life crowns all other temporal favors. As Psa 125:5 , this Psalm closes with a prayer for peace, with prosperity for God's people.
시편-129-1.theologicalNote: 6. Long life crowns all other temporal favors. As Psa 125:5 , this Psalm closes with a prayer for peace, with prosperity for God's people.

시편-129-2.title: 시편 129장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-129-2.exegesis: PSALM 129 Psa 129:1-8 . The people of God, often delivered from enemies, are confident of His favor, by their overthrow in the future. 1-2. may Israel now say-- or, "oh! let Israel say" ( Psa 124:1 ). Israel's youth was the sojourn in Egypt ( Jr 2:2 ; Ho 2:15 ).

시편-129-4.title: 시편 129장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-129-4.exegesis: 3-4. The ploughing is a figure of scourging, which most severe physical infliction aptly represents all kinds.

시편-129-6.title: 시편 129장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-129-6.exegesis: 5-6. The ill-rooted roof grass, which withers before it grows up and procures for those gathering it no harvest blessing ( Ru 2:4 ), sets forth the utter uselessness and the rejection of the wicked.
시편-129-6.theologicalNote: 5-6. The ill-rooted roof grass, which withers before it grows up and procures for those gathering it no harvest blessing ( Ru 2:4 ), sets forth the utter uselessness and the rejection of the wicked.
